bible_quanes.question: From which town was Micah?
From where does the LORD come?
bible_quanes.explanation: He treads the high places of the earth.

bible_quanes.question: What is the transgression of Jacob?
bible_quanes.explanation: And Jerusalem the high places of Judah.

bible_quanes.question: What will God make Samaria?
bible_quanes.answer: As an heap of the field

bible_quanes.question: During the days of which kings did Micah prophesy?
What will happen to the mountains under the Lord?
bible_quanes.answer: They shall be molten, as wax before the fire

bible_quanes.question: How will Micah wail?
How far has the wound reached?
bible_quanes.answer: To Judah, to the gate of Jerusalem

bible_quanes.question: Where are the people told not to tell it?
Which city was the beginning of sin for Zion?
To whom is woe pronounced in Micah 2:1?
bible_quanes.answer: Them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds
bible_quanes.explanation: And practice it at morning light.

bible_quanes.question: What do the wicked covet?
What will God surely gather?
Who will go up before them?
bible_quanes.explanation: Their King will pass before them.

bible_quanes.question: What do the false prophets say?
bible_quanes.explanation: They tell the true prophet to stop.

bible_quanes.question: What do God's words do?
bible_quanes.answer: "Do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?"

bible_quanes.question: Why are the people told to arise and depart?
bible_quanes.answer: This is not their rest, because it is polluted

bible_quanes.question: Whom would the people accept as a prophet?
bible_quanes.answer: A man saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink

bible_quanes.question: What have the oppressors taken from the children?
Like which flock will God put His people together?
With what is Micah full?
bible_quanes.answer: Power by the spirit of the LORD, judgment and might

bible_quanes.question: What will happen to Zion?
bible_quanes.answer: It shall be plowed as a field

bible_quanes.question: How does Micah describe the leaders?
bible_quanes.answer: They hate good and love evil

bible_quanes.question: For what do the priests teach?
bible_quanes.explanation: And the prophets divine for money.

bible_quanes.question: What will happen when the leaders cry to the LORD?
What do the false prophets cry when they have food?
bible_quanes.explanation: And war against those who give nothing.

bible_quanes.question: What will come upon the false prophets?
bible_quanes.answer: Night, that they shall not have a vision

bible_quanes.question: What do the corrupt leaders say?
bible_quanes.answer: "Is not the LORD among us? none evil can come upon us"

bible_quanes.question: With what is Zion built?
What will the temple mountain become?
bible_quanes.answer: As the high places of the forest

bible_quanes.question: What will people do with their swords in Micah 4:3?
Where will everyone sit?
bible_quanes.answer: Under his vine and under his fig tree
bible_quanes.explanation: No one will make them afraid.

bible_quanes.question: What will many nations say?
bible_quanes.answer: "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD"

bible_quanes.question: In whose name will we walk?
What will happen to the mountain of the LORD's house?
bible_quanes.answer: It will be established on the top of the mountains

bible_quanes.question: Whom will God assemble?
bible_quanes.answer: Her that halteth and her that is driven out

bible_quanes.question: To where would the daughter of Zion go?
What is the daughter of Zion told to do?
What does Micah call the tower of the flock?
bible_quanes.answer: The strong hold of the daughter of Zion

bible_quanes.question: What do the nations not understand?
bible_quanes.answer: The thoughts and counsel of the LORD

bible_quanes.question: From which town will the Ruler of Israel come?
What does Micah 5:2 say about the Ruler's goings forth?
bible_quanes.answer: They are from of old, from everlasting

bible_quanes.question: In what strength will the Ruler stand and feed His flock?
What will this One be?
With what will they strike the judge of Israel?
How many shepherds will be raised against the Assyrian?
bible_quanes.answer: Seven shepherds, and eight principal men

bible_quanes.question: To what is the remnant of Jacob compared?
To what else is the remnant compared?
By what name is Assyria called in Micah 5:6?
What will God cut off?
What does the LORD require, according to Micah 6:8?
bible_quanes.answer: To do justly, love mercy and walk humbly with God

bible_quanes.question: What does God ask His people?
bible_quanes.answer: "What have I done to you? And how have I wearied you?"

bible_quanes.question: Whom did God send before Israel?
To whom is Israel told to plead their case?
What did Balak consult about Israel?
What does the worshipper ask about coming before God?
bible_quanes.answer: Shall I come with burnt offerings and calves a year old?

bible_quanes.question: What extreme offer does the worshipper consider?
bible_quanes.answer: "Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression?"

bible_quanes.question: What does God ask about wicked scales?
bible_quanes.answer: "Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances?"

bible_quanes.question: Whose statutes did Israel keep?
bible_quanes.answer: The statutes of Omri, and all the works of the house of Ahab

bible_quanes.question: Which route does Micah 6:5 recall?
What does Micah 7:18 ask?
bible_quanes.answer: "Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity?"

bible_quanes.question: Where will God cast all our sins?
bible_quanes.answer: Into the depths of the sea

bible_quanes.question: What will Micah do?
bible_quanes.answer: Look to the LORD and wait for the God of his salvation

bible_quanes.question: What does Micah say to his enemy?
bible_quanes.answer: "Do not rejoice over me... when I fall, I will arise"

bible_quanes.question: What has perished from the earth?
Whom should one not trust?
Who are a man's enemies?
bible_quanes.answer: The men of his own house

bible_quanes.question: What will God give to Jacob and Abraham?
bible_quanes.answer: Truth to Jacob and mercy to Abraham
bible_quanes.explanation: As He swore to the fathers.

bible_quanes.question: To what does Micah compare himself?
bible_quanes.answer: As when they have gathered the summer fruits: there is no cluster to eat

bible_quanes.question: Where does Micah ask God to feed His people?
